notes.title: Update #10
notes.content: Based on our community feedback we decided to change the in-game economy system completely. We plan to do this in multiple steps. The first is to disable the in-app purchases in the game, so from now the in-game ticket shop is closed. And shortly we plan to remove the game from the store listing too - but it will return with the changes we are working on based on your feedback. During this time the players who already have the game in their library will be able to continue to play. Those who already bought something with our currently used in-app purchase system will have access to the content in the reworked version of the game too, of course.

notes.title: Update #9 - Arcade Surfer
notes.content:
We added a new game to the Funland with this update. The Arcade Surfer is a retro-style shooter experience. If you are a fan of the classic arcade-machine games this one is for you.
And it costs 0 tickets this weekend so everyone has a chance to play a couple of rounds with it.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update #8 - Circa Dial
notes.content:
With this update, we added a new way to win more tickets. The Circa Dial is a futuristic slot machine and every player can use it twice a day to get a chance to win some tickets. Its use is free (no need for tickets or real money) but can only be twice a day.
And something bigger is also coming soon.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update #7 - Ticket pack update & Icarus weekend
notes.content:
With this little update, we want to clarify some things about the in-game ticket system and how it works because we noticed some players a little bit confused about it. So, we added the following statement to the store page:
"IMPORTANT:
This game features a ticket system, which means you need tickets to play certain games. When you first enter the game you will get some FREE tickets, so you can try whatever you want immediately. If you need more tickets you can play minigames (no need for tickets to play them) and WIN more. But if you want to save some time you can also BUY tickets from the in-game store for real money. So, if you like playing minigames you can access all of the content of this game for free unlimitedly, but you can also buy tickets or unlimited access for real money."

We don't want to mislead anybody and try to hide anything behind a paywall, all of the content of this game can be played for free, and if you are willing to play some minigames too (to win more tickets) you can play everything unlimitedly for free. We are a small studio and the development of this game require a lot of time and effort, because of this we needed to add some microtransaction to the game so we can continue its development, but we also wanted to give a chance to everybody to enjoy our game even if they can't afford (or don't want) to spend money on it, so we added the "Game Room" where you can win more tickets unlimitedly and for free (a lot of players already made more tickets here than they can spend, so we think it is not too hard).

But we always want to listen to our community and because of this, we made the Ticket packs bigger by 50% (more tickets for the same price).
And this weekend you can play the "Antihero Icarus" game for 0 tickets.

Technical Troupers Team
